title: Entangled by Society Theatre Company at the HERE Arts Center #entangl...
transcript: Somewhere off of Interstate 40 in New Mexico is a portal to the space time continuum inside of a gas station bathroom. This new piece by Society Theatre Company explores relationships, free will, and quantum entanglement through a series of distinct but occasionally interconnected vignettes. It's a spattering of many ideas, comedically rendered by an ensemble that has a knack for finding clarity in every character, despite some of them only appearing once or twice. Although each scene is captivating and the performances are generally strong, it's clear to me that this piece was at least partially devised. The vision is a bit disjointed and there seem to be some connections in it or meaning behind it that the people involved in the production are aware of but that an average audience member won't be able to pick up on. If engaging with ambiguous and intricate work is your thing, however, you may find this one to be very fruitful.
